title: Appendix containing Canons and Rulings not having Conciliar Origin but Approved by Name in Canon II. of the Synod in Trullo: Of the Same to Agatho the Bishop

verses.text:
Of the Same to Agatho the
Bishop.

Whereas Maximus has for ten years lived in unlawful
marriage, but pretends that it was through ignorance, and that they are
now parted by mutual consent, let them stand among the catechumens, if
it appear that they be in earnest.
